description: This file defines the PduPart class, representing a part of a multimedia message (MMS) in the PDU protocol. It includes constants for header fields, methods for managing part data (byte array or URI), and properties such as content ID, charset, content location, filename, and content type. The class allows constructing and accessing different headers and content-related parameters of an MMS part.

classes.name: PduPart
classes.description: Represents a media or data part within an MMS message; provides methods to set and retrieve headers and content data, including content type, disposition, transfer encoding, and identifiers.

methods.name: setData
methods.description: Sets the part's data as a byte array.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns a copy of the part's data byte array.

methods.name: getDataLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the part data.

methods.name: setDataUri
methods.description: Sets the data URI for the part.

methods.name: getDataUri
methods.description: Returns the URI of the part data.

methods.name: setContentId
methods.description: Sets the content ID header field.

methods.name: getContentId
methods.description: Retrieves the content ID header value.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name parameter for the content type.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename parameter in content disposition.

methods.name: generateLocation
methods.description: Generates a location string for referencing the part, using content location, filename, or content ID.
